title: GRIP Service — Session Response
description: HTTP response body for POST /v1/sessions. Confirms the session and reports available verification capabilities.

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier. Used in all subsequent verify requests.

protocolVersion.description: GRIP protocol version this service implements.

frameworksAvailable.description: All compliance frameworks this service supports.

frameworksActive.description: Frameworks activated for this session (intersection of requested and available).

coverage.description: Backend-specific coverage metadata. Keys are backend names (e.g. 'guard', 'trivy'). Values are backend-specific objects describing rule counts, scanner versions, etc.
